description: This file contains the implementation of a parser for GN build files, including token parsing, syntax tree construction, and comment assignment.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A recursive descent parser for GN build files, capable of tokenizing, parsing expressions, statements, blocks, and handling comments.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Base class for all nodes in the parse tree.

classes.name: LiteralNode
classes.description: Represents a literal value (integer, string, boolean).

classes.name: IdentifierNode
classes.description: Represents an identifier in the syntax tree.

classes.name: FunctionCallNode
classes.description: Represents a function call with arguments and optional block.

classes.name: BinaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents a binary operation in the syntax tree.

classes.name: BlockNode
classes.description: Represents a block of statements, such as function bodies or conditional blocks.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment attached to syntax nodes.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse a list of tokens into a parse tree.

methods.name: ParseExpression
methods.description: Parses an expression with precedence handling.

methods.name: ParseValue
methods.description: Parses a literal value or expression.

methods.name: IsAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a node is an assignment operation.

methods.name: IsStatementBreak
methods.description: Determines if a token type indicates a statement boundary.

methods.name: LookAhead
methods.description: Checks if the next token matches a given type.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Consumes a token if it matches the expected type.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes and returns the current token.

methods.name: ParseFile
methods.description: Parses the entire file into a block node.

methods.name: ParseStatement
methods.description: Parses a single statement or expression.

methods.name: ParseBlock
methods.description: Parses a block of statements enclosed in braces.

methods.name: AssignComments
methods.description: Assigns comments to syntax nodes based on position.
